name: Block IP Address for WooCommerce
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description:
Block IP Address for WooCommerce is a powerful, lightweight, and easy-to-use plugin that allows you to block IP addresses in WooCommerce and protect your online store from spam, bots, and unwanted visitors.

With this plugin, you can restrict access to your WooCommerce shop, homepage, or specific product categories using simple IP-based rules. When a visitor’s IP address matches a blocked entry, they are automatically redirected to a page of your choice.

This plugin is ideal for store owners who want to block IP address in WooCommerce, control user access, and improve website security without any complex configuration.

Why Block IP Addresses?
– Easily block IP address in WooCommerce
– Prevent spam, bots, and malicious traffic
– Improve store security with IP-based restrictions
– Control who can access your shop or categories

Key Features:
– Easily add & manage blocked IP addresses.
– Define block duration using start and end dates.
– Redirect blocked IPs to Shop Page.
– Redirect blocked IPs to Home Page.
– Redirect blocked IPs to Specific Category.
– Lightweight and simple to configure.
– No coding requireds.
– Compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions.

Why This Plugin Stands Out
Unlike complex security plugins, Block IP Address for WooCommerce focuses only on what you need — simple, fast, and effective IP blocking with flexible control.

Perfect For
– Store owners who want to block IP address in WooCommerce.
– Preventing fake traffic and spam users
– Restricting access to specific users or regions
– Temporarily blocking suspicious visitors

Contacts

If you need assistance, please visit our website at wpcraft.net or contact our support team at info@wpcraft.net.
sections.faq:
How can I block an IP address in WooCommerce?

Simply add the IP address from the plugin settings, choose a redirect page, and save changes.

Can I set a duration for blocked IPs?

Yes. You can define a start and end date for each blocked IP. The restriction will only be active within this time period.

Can I redirect blocked users to a custom page?

Yes, you can select any page on your website for redirection.

Does this block access to the entire WooCommerce site?

No, you can choose to block only the shop page, homepage, or specific categories.

Can I block IP ranges?

Currently, only individual IP addresses are supported. IP range support may be added in future updates.

Does this affect website performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for speed.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most major caching plugins.

Can I block IPs temporarily?

Yes, you can set start and end dates for each IP block.
